_comment: events.json — Featured events on the Home tab. Two date styles: (A) "date": "2026-11-18T17:30:00" (+ optional "endDate") — exact time, works on all app versions; (B) "day": "2026-10-30" (+ optional "time": "17:00", "endDay", "repeat": "weekly") — no set time / multi-day / weekly series, shown on app v1.0.9+ only. Past events auto-hide. image: {"uri": "https://..."}. Optional url = registration/details link.
